title: 第5章 夜窥秘辛符文指引迷途第6章 灭口密令李慕白领命
slug: 长生从假死开始万年之后我还在
content_zh:
鸡鸣两遍，破晓微光刺破夜幕。
后山柴房死寂沉沉。
陈默死死贴在屋檐阴影中，整个人压低重心蹲伏，身形与黑暗融为一体。双耳极致张开，精准锁定数丈外厨房传来的碗筷磕碰声。
送饭的杂役，来了。
他纹丝不动，呼吸压至近乎断绝，躯体僵如石块。
草丛深处，那枚昨夜从门缝滑出的钥匙，沾满晨露，静静躺着。
他不碰。
时机未到，一动即死。
吱呀——
柴房木门被推开半尺，刺眼天光切入屋内。
杂役探头扫了一圈，见陈默依旧蜷缩昏睡，毫无异动，当即放下心来。随手将一碗冷硬辟谷饼、一瓢浑米汤搁在门槛内侧，转身就要关门走人。
就在木门即将合拢的刹那！
陈默身形一闪！
贴身滑步，无声无息，衣角不带半分风声，瞬息掠出柴房，指尖顺势轻抵门板，让木门堪堪虚掩。
全程快到极致。
杂役浑然未觉，拎着空托盘哼着小曲，渐行渐远。
陈默并未起身逃窜，顺势趴伏墙根，目光死死钉在青石地面。
三步之外，肉眼难辨的淡灵光纹路，顺着石缝缓慢游走。
灵觉侦测阵！
半盏茶一次全域扫查，但凡捕捉一丝灵力波动，执法堂即刻瞬至。

他默数七息，静静等纹路扫过、灵光彻底沉寂。
抬手抹脸，故意保留的泥污、干痂、乱须尽数覆面，疯癫废徒的外表完美无缺，遮掩住眼底所有清明锋芒。
如今全宗人人认定——陈默坠崖摔碎脑子，只剩一具无用废躯。
这是他唯一的掩护。
起身贴紧围墙阴影，全程避开主道巡哨动线。
他熟记玄霄宗每一处死角密道。药园西侧枯井，十年前暴雨冲垮的塌口，藤蔓疯缠，荒草封路，早已被所有弟子遗忘。
身形钻入围障，匍匐五丈暗渠，从后山土坡塌陷口悄然翻出。
已然抵达后山禁地外围。
前方一座废弃练功台赫然入目，断桩歪斜，石板裂生野草，昔日雷火毁阵之后，此地阴气淤积，无人踏足。
陈默矮身藏在残碑之后，屏息敛气。
二十步外，两名巡山弟子提灯缓步走过，佩剑松弛，脚步懒散。
“陈默那疯子关在柴房，跑不了，天天巡后山纯属白费功夫。”
“走走形式罢了，一个废徒而已，翻不起浪。”
闲谈声渐行渐远，彻底消散在林道尽头。
陈默即刻动身，直奔断龙崖北侧阴坡。
此地终年背阴，苔藓厚密，湿滑难行，极少有人靠近。
他对照坠崖瞬间烙印神魂的画面，精准比对岩壁纹路、裂缝朝向、岩缝角度。
content_en:
The cock crows twice, and the dim light of dawn pierces the night.
The woodshed in the back hill was deathly silent.
Chen Mo clung to the shadow of the eaves, lowering his center of gravity and crouching, his body blending into the darkness. He opened his ears to the extreme and accurately focused on the sound of clinking bowls and chopsticks coming from the kitchen a few feet away.
The handyman delivering food is here.
He was motionless, his breathing almost stopped, and his body was as stiff as a stone.
Deep in the grass, the key that slipped out of the door last night was covered with morning dew and lay quietly.
He doesn't touch.
Before the time comes, you will die if you move.
Squeak——
The wooden door of the woodshed was pushed open half a foot, and dazzling skylight penetrated into the house.
The handyman glanced around and saw that Chen Mo was still curled up and sleeping, with no movement, and he was immediately relieved. He casually placed a bowl of cold big grain cakes and a ladle of pure rice soup on the inside of the threshold, turned around and was about to close the door and leave.
Just when the wooden door is about to close!
Chen Mo's figure flashed!
Sliding close to the body, silently, without any sound of wind at the corners of his clothes, he swept out of the woodshed in an instant, and his fingertips lightly touched the door panel, leaving the wooden door barely concealed.
The whole process was extremely fast.
The handyman was completely unaware, humming a tune while carrying an empty tray, and drifted away.
Chen Mo did not get up and run away, but lay down on the wall, his eyes fixed on the bluestone ground.
Three steps away, lines of light spiritual light that were difficult to discern with the naked eye slowly traveled along the cracks in the stone.
Spiritual Sense Detection Array!
Half a cup of tea scans the entire area at once, and if it catches a trace of spiritual energy fluctuation, the law enforcement hall will arrive immediately.
He silently counted seven breaths and waited quietly for the lines to sweep over and the aura to completely silence.
He raised his hand to wipe his face, covering his face with all the mud, scabs and tangled beard that he had deliberately retained. His perfect appearance as a madman and a useless person covered all the clear and sharp edges in his eyes.
Now everyone in the sect believes that Chen Mo fell off a cliff and shattered his brain, leaving only a useless body.
It was his only cover.
Get up and stick to the shadow of the wall, avoiding the patrol line on the main road.
He knew every secret passage in the Xuanxiao Sect by heart. The dry well on the west side of the medicine garden was destroyed by heavy rain ten years ago. The vines are tangled and the road is blocked by weeds. It has long been forgotten by all the disciples.
The body got through the barrier, crawled five feet into the culvert, and quietly emerged from the collapse of the back mountain slope.
We have arrived at the outskirts of the Houshan Forbidden Area.
In front of you, you can see an abandoned training platform. The broken piles are crooked and the stone slabs are cracked with weeds. After the thunder and fire destroyed the formation in the past, the Yin Qi accumulated here and no one has set foot on it.
Chen Mo hid behind the broken monument, holding his breath.
Twenty steps away, two mountain patrol disciples walked slowly past with lanterns, their swords were slack and their steps were lazy.
"That lunatic Chen Mo is locked up in the woodshed and can't escape. Patrolling the mountains behind every day is a waste of effort."
"It's just a formality. He's just a loser. He can't make trouble."
The chatter gradually faded away and completely disappeared at the end of the forest road.
Chen Mo set off immediately and headed straight for the shady slope on the north side of Broken Dragon Cliff.
This place is shaded all year round, with thick moss and slippery terrain, and very few people come near it.
He accurately compared the texture of the rock wall, the direction of the cracks, and the angle of the rock crevices by comparing the images that imprinted his soul upon falling off the cliff.
